name: Reworx
old_description: At Reworx, we create custom furniture and accents that merge sustainability with exceptional craftsmanship. By giving new life to reclaimed materials, we design pieces that transform spaces and tell meaningful stories. Committed to innovation, quality, and environmental responsibility, we combine timeless style with modern function to craft designs that embody both artistry and purpose.
about:
Reworx operates from Morris, Connecticut, with a shop in Watertown and a studio on Watertown Road in Morris. The company was founded by a family team that includes Steve and Joshua, who lead a close-knit group of craftspeople dedicated to giving new life to reclaimed materials.

The business designs and builds custom furniture and accents — such as reclaimed barn‑wood mantels — using salvaged lumber and other reclaimed stock. Services include a design studio where clients collaborate with reclamation experts, direct sales of salvaged wood for DIY projects, and a mobile on‑site design and installation consultation service for residential and commercial spaces.

Reworx serves homeowners, interior designers, and commercial clients seeking sustainable, story‑rich pieces for both private residences and public spaces. The salvage and wood sales channel also caters to DIY enthusiasts looking for reclaimed material for their own projects.

The founders frame the venture around sustainability, craftsmanship, and environmental responsibility, aiming to combine timeless style with modern function so that each piece transforms a space while telling a meaningful story.
